name: Biomedical KG Similarity Dataset Collection
description: A collection of benchmark datasets for evaluating knowledge graph-based similarity measures in the biomedical domain.
evaluation_method: Spearman/Pearson correlation (rank and linear correlation between predicted and reference similarity scores)
reputation: Moderately used in biomedical KG and bioinformatics research for evaluating KG-based similarity measures; adoption is mainly academic/specialist.
notes: Collection of heterogeneous datasets with varying sizes and ontologies; non-LLM benchmark. Results are sensitive to preprocessing, choice of graph embedding/measure, and dataset-specific characteristics.
